demos.description: Top-down arena shooter for 1-8 players: thrust, turn, blast asteroids and each other, first to 15 points wins.

demos.name: Sky Hoppers
demos.title: Sky Hoppers
demos.description: Co-op platformer for 1-4 players: run and jump through a tilemap level with coins, spikes, moving platforms and shared checkpoints.

demos.name: Paddle Rush
demos.title: Paddle Rush
demos.description: Air hockey with an AI opponent when you are alone. In team mode everyone on a side steers the same paddle: inputs are averaged in real time.

demos.title: Cube Racers
demos.description: WebGL arcade racer for 1-6 players: drive kart cubes around a walled circuit with cones and chicanes, chase camera, checkpoints and lap timing.

demos.name: Tower Together
demos.title: Tower Together
demos.description: Co-op tower defence for 1-4 players: click or tap to build turrets along the road, share one purse of gold and hold the base through escalating waves.
